detail.readme: Awesome-MaterialDesign ================== A curated list of awesome Android MaterialDesign res and libraries. Feel free to contrubute. ##Other Awesome List * [awesome](https://github.com/sindresorhus/awesome) * [awesome-android](https://github.com/snowdream/awesome-android) * [awesome-android-ui](https://github.com/wasabeef/awesome-android-ui) * [awesome-java](https://github.com/akullpp/awesome-java) * [awesome-ios-ui](https://github.com/cjwirth/awesome-ios-ui) * [awesome-swift](https://github.com/matteocrippa/awesome-swift) * [awesome-svg](https://github.com/willianjusten/awesome-svg) * [awesome-resources](https://github.com/lyfeyaj/awesome-resources) * [awesome-awesomeness](https://github.com/bayandin/awesome-awesomeness) ##
